property.name: echidna_wallet_accounting_respected()
property.source: OWASP Smart Contract Security Testing Guide, SCSVS-GOV Business Logic and Economic Security overview; OWASP SC02:2026 Business Logic Vulnerabilities
property.semantic: For the WalletHarness account, cumulative ETH received through successful withdraw/refund calls must never exceed cumulative ETH deposited through the harness deposit action.
property.formalization_note: This invariant operationalizes the independent standard's business-logic, economic-accounting, and path-dependent-state guidance; it is not quoted as a verbatim normative requirement.
preconditions: The harness is the only caller of the Wallet instance, so it is the single ledger account under test.
Deposits are forwarded to Wallet and counted only after the Wallet call succeeds.
Withdrawals/refunds are counted by the actual ETH balance increase of the harness after successful calls.
The Echidna property is evaluated after each completed transaction sequence.
limitations: Owner-only migrateTo is outside the per-user deposit/withdraw/refund accounting property and is not exposed as a harness action.
Forced ETH and transfers outside the harness actions are outside the measured ledger.
The selected sample has a public known vulnerability annotation and is only an engineering-flow pilot.
A refund has no ABI parameters; withdraw(amount) reads Wallet's private mapping, so parameter-repair applicability must be observed rather than assumed.

leakage_controls.transformation: Remove block and line comments, preserve line breaks, and strip trailing horizontal whitespace; Solidity tokens and business logic remain unchanged.
leakage_controls.agent_source_root_boundary: The V2 source root is the test directory only; the annotated upstream copy is stored outside it.

echidna_preflight.purpose: Confirm the property executes; not part of the G0/G1/G2 comparison.

comparison.gate: Run only after a repaired candidate completes Anvil replay, reaches the frozen target state, and the corresponding full seed replay in Echidna is independently verified.

groups.G2: The same candidate after the single execution-feedback repair.

comparison.failure_retention: Keep raw candidates, invalid seeds, transaction failures, replay logs, and any coverage decline.
